item.title: Apple's 1st foldable phone launched: Specifications, features & price in India of iPhone Duo
item.description: Apple has launched the iPhone Duo, its first foldable phone, at Rs 2,99,900 in India. It opens to a 7.6-inch display with a 5.4-inch screen outside, runs the A20 Pro chip, and carries a battery on each side for up to 24 hours of use. Touch ID replaces Face ID, and the phone is eSIM-only. Pre-orders open on October 16, with sales from October 23.

item.title: Pegula vs Navarro: The $15 billion 'battle' that dwarfed Djokovic, Federer and Nadal's wealth
item.description: Jessica Pegula staged a stunning comeback in her US Open quarter-final against Emma Navarro after losing the first set. Securing victory, Pegula progresses to the semi-finals for the third consecutive year, showcasing her resilience on the court. Meanwhile, Navarro's impressive journey to the quarter-finals hints at a bright future in tennis, with both athletes coming from families boasting a combined net worth of fifteen billion dollars.

item.title: New Yorker cleaned same block for 100 days; then neighbours joined in
item.description: David Clarke took it upon himself to clean a neglected block in New York City using simple tools. His shared updates on social media sparked wider community interest, leading to a collaborative effort. He invested his own funds to create gardens in tree beds, inspiring neighbors to participate in maintaining the area. This grassroots initiative revitalized the block and fostered a sense of community pride in public spaces.

item.title: Sarah Michelle Gellar cuts LA home asking price to $9.95 million
item.description: Sarah Michelle Gellar and Freddie Prinze Jr. have decided to drop the price of their Mandeville Canyon home, now listed at $9.95 million. This price cut comes only three months after the property was first put on the market. The couple bought this family residence in 2013 and is now eager to find a buyer for their beloved Los Angeles home.

item.title: Apple increases prices of iPhone 17 series, iPhone Air & iPhone 16
item.description: With the unveiling of the iPhone 18 Pro series, Apple has raised prices for its devices in India. The iPhone 17e and iPhone 16 are also affected by substantial price increases. The iPhone 17 now retails for Rs 99,900, marked up by Rs 17,000, whereas the premium iPhone Air skyrocketed by Rs 30,000. Highlights of the new iPhone 17 encompass a 120Hz display and upgraded 48MP cameras.

item.title: 3 trucks of debris, 1 missing wall: How renovation doomed Delhi PG building
item.description: Delhi Police investigation revealed renovation work weakened the Satya Niketan building structure. Renovation involved levelling the basement and removing a ground floor wall for a shop. A labour contractor was arrested and stated Mahesh Gupta paid him daily for the work. The building's paying guest operator was also arrested for negligence. Seven people died after the five-storey building collapsed on September 6.

item.title: Over 10 feared trapped as under-construction building collapses in Gandhinagar
item.description: An under-construction building collapsed in Gandhinagar's Kudasan area on Wednesday. Fire department teams immediately launched rescue operations at the affected construction site. This incident follows a recent building collapse in Delhi which tragically killed seven people. Authorities are continuing their rescue efforts in Gandhinagar while awaiting further details. The event has renewed scrutiny of building safety and construction practices nationwide.

item.description: Oil prices have soared past the $100 mark per barrel, resulting in a dip in Wall Street's performance. This increase has amplified worries over fuel costs and inflation for both consumers and businesses alike. With petrol prices showing a 32% increase compared to last year, household finances are feeling the strain.

item.title: He scored 99th percentile in CAT but chose Army; meet Col Anurag Upadhyay
item.description: Colonel Anurag Upadhyay, a former Indian Army Special Forces officer, is seeking expert medical and technological support after suffering a severe stroke in August 2025 that resulted in locked-in syndrome and bilateral below-knee amputations. Despite remaining conscious and communicating through eye movements, his family is exploring advanced rehabilitation, neurological research and assistive technologies such as brain-computer interfaces and eye-tracking systems. A public appeal seeks credible specialists, institutions and organisations that could help identify further possibilities for recovery and independence.
item.dc:creator: SANJAY SHARMA

item.title: ‘Wanted to teach him lesson’: Delhi accused on assault that killed Manipuri musician
item.description: Seven men and a juvenile were arrested for the alleged killing of Chongtham Vikram Singh. The accused reportedly assaulted the musician after he objected to noise outside his home. Singh, a musician, died hours after the assault due to internal injuries. Police are investigating all aspects, including a potential racial angle in the incident. The North Eastern Students' Organisation demanded a swift and impartial probe into the matter.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Watch: Ferry erupts in flames off Philippines’ Palawan; 5 killed
item.description: Tragedy struck as the M/V June Aster passenger ferry ignited flames near Coron, Palawan, claiming at least five lives, as confirmed by officials. The Philippine Coast Guard swiftly initiated rescue missions, successfully saving 42 individuals from the inferno. The ill-fated ferry had embarked on its journey from Manila, carrying numerous passengers and crew members.
item.dc:creator: TRISHA MAHAJAN

item.title: Belgium sinks 23 giant concrete blocks to build world's first energy island
item.description: Belgium is constructing the world's first artificial energy island in the North Sea. This massive structure will collect electricity from offshore wind farms and transmit it ashore. The island's design incorporates nature-inclusive elements to support marine life and bird species. While civil engineering nears completion, electrical infrastructure installation will continue until 2030. The project aims to become operational around 2030, enhancing European electricity exchange.

item.title: Jeremy Corbyn finds buyer for £700,000 London home after 19 years
item.description: Jeremy Corbyn has found a buyer for his three-bedroom Finsbury Park home after 19 years. The former Labour leader bought the North London property for £363,000 in 2007 and initially listed it for £800,000 this year. The house was later reduced to offers over £700,000 and is now under offer, according to reports.

item.title: ‘Pilot is a good leader’: Channi backs new Punjab Congress in-charge
item.description: Sachin Pilot's appointment as Punjab Congress in-charge brings new hope to party workers. He is seen as a capable leader who can unite various factions within the state unit. This move aims to strengthen the Congress party's position before the upcoming 2027 Assembly elections. Leaders like Charanjit Singh Channi and Sukhjinder Singh Randhawa welcomed the decision. The party is planning a statewide yatra to revive its organizational activities.

item.title: Nepal’s flood bill could hit $5 billion. Where will the money come from?
item.description: Following the catastrophic floods, Nepal is staring down an enormous reconstruction cost running into billions. To restore infrastructure and homes effectively, both local resources and international assistance will play pivotal roles. The nation is actively pursuing funding opportunities with development banks and climate finance, emphasizing the importance of resilient rebuilding strategies for securing its long-term future.

item.title: New satellite images show major construction surge at Iran’s Pickaxe nuke site
item.description: Construction activity has significantly increased at Iran's underground Pickaxe Mountain nuclear site this year. The United States is developing new weapons to target deeply buried facilities. President Trump has repeatedly threatened strikes on the heavily fortified Iranian location. The US military maintains operational plans for potential strikes against the site. This renewed scrutiny occurs as the wider US-Iran conflict intensifies.

item.description: Amitabh Bachchan is back as the host of Kaun Banega Crorepati for its eighteenth season, continuing to enthrall viewers with emotional narratives and engaging challenges.
